description: This test verifies that a user can successfully authenticate using Google OAuth, ensuring the integration with Google's authentication service functions as expected.
steps: Click on the Google authentication button.
Verify that the user is redirected to Google's OAuth login page.
Input a valid Google email in the email field.
Input the correct password for the account.
Verify that the user is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai/login with a valid session.
Verify that the user is logged in and redirected to the primary application dashboard.
expected_results: User is redirected to Google's OAuth login page.
User successfully logs in with valid Google credentials.
User is redirected back to the Roost application dashboard.
A valid user session is created and maintained.
edge_cases: User enters an invalid email address.
User cancels the login process at Google's OAuth page.
Google's OAuth service is temporarily unavailable.
User's Google account does not have the required permissions.
data_requirements: A valid Google account with active credentials.
Test credentials for a Google account.
Redirect URI set up correctly in the application.
Session management configured in the application.
dependencies: Google OAuth service must be operational.
The Roost application must have a valid Google client ID and secret.
The login page must be accessible.
The OAuth redirect URI must be correctly configured.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect to Google's OAuth page.
Time taken to authenticate and redirect back to the application.
Load time of the login page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Google login button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify that the button has appropriate ARIA roles and labels.
Ensure the login page is screen-reader friendly.
Verify contrast ratios on the login page meet WCAG standards.
